searchText: the main thing we need is confidence that data will continue to be retrievable. if portal provides it, then good i don't expect us integrate portal into our client - e.g. in case the user makes an rpc request for something that has expired, we go fetch it on portal So Geth wouldn’t integrate a Client into their client, but users could optionally run a Portal Client which could be configured as a fallback for certain RPC requests? I'm just speaking from my own POV, maybe others on the team see it differently. I'm not sure what it would mean for a portal client to be a fallback, but it isn't logic I would want to be in geth. To me it makes far more sense for users who want a light client to just run a portal client which provides the RPCs Nothing wrong with that
